scope: Refresh dwg-rs writer maturity and correct peer-comparison plan statements using the current public README and its route-specific limitations.

method.kind: Public project documentation and existing plan cross-check
method.evidenceBoundary: The current main-branch README is mutable and was not tied to an immutable commit in this review. Its status descriptions are project claims, not observed output behavior. No local or peer runtime result was produced.

evidence.topic: Experimental DWG byte assembly versus CLI scaffold
observed: The README describes an experimental R2004-family DwgFile::to_bytes() assembly path using a bit writer, literal-only LZ77 encoder, section framer, Sec_Mask, CRC, and page-map/section-info assembly.
The capability table describes DWG and DXF writers as alpha; the README also documents an alpha DXF writer and states that a DXF parser is not implemented.

The same README says its Stage 1 dwg-write CLI scaffold does not emit valid DWG, R14 and R2007 writing are unavailable, and external-CAD acceptance and byte-identical DWG round-trips are not automated or claimed.
doesNotEstablish: that the current byte-assembly API emits a DWG accepted by an independent strict reader
that any DWG version or DXF writer route has external CAD acceptance
a production-ready or complete writer implementation
evidence.planUse: Correct stale no-writer wording to identify experimental code without promoting writer support. Retain dwg-rs as an optional structural comparator; any output probe is discovery-only and composed-checkpoint-only, with exact source pin, generated input, actual target magic, independent strict parse, and native result recorded separately.

evidence.topic: Coverage-report denominator and shared specification lineage
observed: The version table reports 3,911 decoded, 525 skipped, and 9 errored records across 19 files (88.0%).
A later verification paragraph reports 90.3% aggregate and 85.9% AC1032, while a capability row still says 95.6%; the figures do not identify one consistent snapshot/denominator.
The project identifies ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 as its format reference and reports cross-checking an LZ77 interpretation against ACadSharp algorithm comments.
doesNotEstablish: semantic parity from headline coverage percentages
independent resolution of ambiguities in the shared ODA specification
a fully independent LZ77 implementation vote for the specifically cross-checked interpretation
evidence.planUse: Use matched per-version/per-family results only. Treat dwg-rs as implementation-diverse but specification-lineage-shared; do not use aggregate percentages or its shared-reference conclusions to promote support.

nextActions: Keep local fast implementation work independent of peer installation or runtime availability.
If a dwg-rs output route becomes useful, first pin an immutable source revision and execute only a locally generated, narrow control at the existing composed checkpoint.
Separate experimental writer code, command-line scaffold, independent parse result, actual target version, and native CAD result in any evidence ledger.
Keep all six external-only J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

validation.notes: The receipt JSON was parsed with jq and the plan passed git diff --check. No peer execution, native qualification, local test, fixture, or support promotion occurred.
